Mission Local’s data takeaways were: turnout was about 412,000, down 38,000 from 2020 despite a similar number of registered voters; Proposition H helped shift some races to even-year elections, when turnout is higher; a citywide measure passed 55–45, a 35,600-vote difference; a heavily funded measure was rejected by 13 percent, or 48,887 votes; redistricting likely hurt Dean Preston and helped Myrna Melgar; and in new precincts, Philhour received 52 percent of first-choice votes.
